featured_reviews.review_text:
-5/5

Extremely disappointing experience at the Kandivali East branch.

There was a dog sitting right at the salon entrance, and it appeared aggressive. Since we were uncomfortable approaching it, we requested assistance from the salon staff to help us enter safely. A staff member came out very reluctantly and made only a token effort to move the dog away.

Before we could even enter the salon premises, the dog suddenly came forward and bit one of us without any provocation. What was even more shocking was the complete lack of concern shown afterward. The staff were clearly aware of what had happened, yet none of the team members came out to check on us, offer assistance, or even ask if we were okay.

When customers are standing at your entrance seeking to enter your establishment, ensuring a safe entry is a basic responsibility. At the very least, one would expect basic human courtesy and empathy after such an incident. Instead, the team simply watched from a distance and avoided getting involved.

The incident itself was unfortunate, but the complete lack of empathy, responsibility, and concern from the staff made the experience far worse.

Worst experience.
